canDoYue: 你識講咳嗽同過敏，仲識問劑量同飯後食藥。
canDoEn: Describe a cough and an allergy, then ask about the dosage and taking a tablet after meals.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello. I have a bad cough today, and I need something from this pharmacy please.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我今日咳得犀利，想喺呢間藥房買啲藥。
dialogue.say: Hello. I have a bad cough today, and I need something from this pharmacy please.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: What other symptom should I note down before the pharmacist checks you over?
dialogue.glossYue: 藥劑師檢查你之前，我仲要記低咩症狀？
dialogue.say: What other symptom should I note down before the pharmacist checks you over?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have a drug allergy, so please check the box carefully before you choose.
dialogue.glossYue: 我對藥物過敏，揀之前請小心睇盒。
dialogue.say: I have a drug allergy, so please check the box carefully before you choose.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: The dosage is one small tablet twice a day for five days.
dialogue.glossYue: 劑量係一日兩次，每次一粒，連續五日。
dialogue.say: The dosage is one small tablet twice a day for five days.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I can always take it after meals if that is safer for my stomach.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果對胃安全啲，我可以飯後先食。
dialogue.say: I can always take it after meals if that is safer for my stomach.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: I will write a short prescription and put it in the pharmacy bag.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會寫張短處方，放進藥房袋。
dialogue.say: I will write a short prescription and put it in the pharmacy bag.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please repeat the dosage once more here before I pay for the box.
dialogue.glossYue: 我畀錢之前，請喺呢度再講一次劑量。
dialogue.say: Please repeat the dosage once more here before I pay for the box.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Please rest at home, and call us if that cough comes back later on.
dialogue.glossYue: 請返屋企休息。如果之後再咳，就打畀我哋。
dialogue.say: Please rest at home, and call us if that cough comes back later on.
